summary: US stocks sold off hard on Wednesday 25 Nov in a renewed AI-led slide: Nasdaq down roughly 3-4%, S&P 500 about -2.5%, VIX back above 30 and Fear and Greed at extreme fear, after a -1.5% Nasdaq day on Tuesday. Nvidia fell 8% in early trading after losing 5.9% on Tuesday (Huang CEO-return rally faded). Gold fell 2.4% and long bonds rose 1.1%. US markets are closed Thursday 26 Nov for Thanksgiving, so Europe trades without Wall Street guidance and may react late to the Wednesday tech rout; chip and tech names look exposed.
